exposure: direct application of an experimental product to the spinal cord
outcome: Motor function abnormalities (evaluated by sheep locomotor rating scale)
cohort: Fetal ovine lambs, comprising a surgical intervention group (n=5) and a control group (n=6), were used to develop a model for fetal spinal cord exposure.
finding: The developed model allowed for long-term postnatal survival of lambs (3 months) after fetal spinal cord exposure and direct product application, with no observed motor function abnormalities or increased spinal angulation in the intervention group.
gest_age: Intervention at GA 100-106; delivery at GA 140-142
